claim: llm-d's model-server and EPP metrics scraping is built entirely on Kubernetes-native Prometheus-Operator CRDs (PodMonitor for model servers, ServiceMonitor for the EPP), so a non-Kubernetes backend loses this auto-discovery/scrape-configuration mechanism and must supply its own static Prometheus scrape_configs.
stance_target: gap (c): EPP-to-model-server metrics scraping outside Kubernetes requires custom scrape configuration, not just a network-reachable /metrics endpoint
scope_conditions: llm-d docs v0.9 (current, as of fetch)
quoted_support: The monitoring component creates PodMonitors that scrape model server metrics... EPP (Endpoint Picker) metrics are enabled by default. To verify or enable manually, see the Monitoring & Tracing Configuration section in the llm-d-router Helm chart docs. Verify the ServiceMonitor exists.

claim: The reference troubleshooting workflow verifies model-server metrics endpoints over plain HTTP by default (curl against port 8000), and TLS between Prometheus and its scrape targets is an explicit opt-in configuration, not a default -- indicating EPP/Prometheus-to-model-server metrics scraping is unencrypted absent deliberate operator action.
stance_target: gap (c): absence of default TLS/mTLS on the metrics-scraping path between EPP/Prometheus and model servers
scope_conditions: llm-d docs v0.9 troubleshooting section, install-prometheus-grafana.sh script
quoted_support: The autoscaler is configured for HTTPS but Prometheus is serving HTTP. Enable TLS: ./guides/recipes/observability/install-prometheus-grafana.sh --enable-tls

claim: llm-d exposes a large, specific EPP metric surface (llm_d_epp_request_ttft_seconds, llm_d_epp_scheduler_e2e_duration_seconds, llm_d_epp_plugin_duration_seconds, flow-control queue/saturation metrics, etc.) that a custom router implementation should preserve or replicate to remain compatible with existing llm-d Grafana dashboards and alerting.
stance_target: observability-parity requirement for a customized router
scope_conditions: llm-d docs v0.9 EPP metrics reference
